# Acorn

`acorn.cjs` is the unchanged CommonJS distribution of Acorn 8.19.0, licensed
under the MIT license in `ACORN-LICENSE`. It has no runtime dependencies.
Harness embeds it with the Node worker so eval needs no npm installation.
It parses cell declarations, imports, and kernel tool signatures.

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/acorn/-/acorn-8.19.0.tgz
Upstream: https://github.com/acornjs/acorn
